data.name: CategoryNotaryInconsistency
data.value: Notary inconsistency

data.name: MessageNotaryInconsistency
data.value: The notary in your profile ("{0}") differs from the notary in your will ("{1}"). Is this correct?

data.name: SuggestionNotaryInconsistency
data.value: Check whether you mean the same notary and update the details.

data.name: CategoryNotaryEmergency
data.value: Notary emergency contact

data.name: MessageNotaryEmergency
data.value: Notary "{0}" is listed in your will but not registered as an emergency contact.

data.name: SuggestionNotaryEmergency
data.value: Add your notary as an emergency contact with their phone number.

data.name: CategoryFuneralDirectorEmergency
data.value: Funeral director emergency contact

data.name: MessageFuneralDirectorEmergency
data.value: Funeral director "{0}" is not registered as an emergency contact.

data.name: SuggestionFuneralDirectorEmergency
data.value: Add your funeral director as an emergency contact.

data.name: CategoryMissingEmergencyContact
data.value: Missing emergency contact

data.name: MessageMissingGP
data.value: No general practitioner is registered as an emergency contact. A GP is important in the event of death and for medical documentation.

data.name: SuggestionAddGP
data.value: Add your general practitioner as an emergency contact.

data.name: CategoryHeirEmergencyLink
data.value: Heir ↔ Emergency contact

data.name: MessageHeirNotEmergency
data.value: Heir "{0}" is not registered as an emergency contact. Consider adding this person as an emergency contact so they can be reached in an emergency.

data.name: SuggestionGoToEmergencyContacts
data.value: Go to Emergency Contacts and add this person.

data.name: CategoryEmergencyHeirLink
data.value: Emergency contact ↔ Heir

data.name: MessageEmergencyNotHeir
data.value: Trusted person "{0}" is not registered as an heir. Would you like to add this person as an heir as well?

data.name: SuggestionGoToHeirs
data.value: Go to Heirs and add this person.

data.name: CategoryBeneficiaryHeirLink
data.value: Beneficiary ↔ Heir

data.name: MessageBeneficiaryNotHeir
data.value: Beneficiary "{0}" in the will is not registered as an heir.

data.name: SuggestionCheckBeneficiaryHeir
data.value: Check whether this person should also be added as an heir.

data.name: CategoryExecutorEmergencyLink
data.value: Executor ↔ Emergency contact

data.name: MessageExecutorNotEmergency
data.value: Executor "{0}" is named in the will but not registered as an emergency contact. Heirs will be unable to reach the executor directly.

data.name: CategoryEmergencyNoPhone
data.value: Emergency contact without phone number

data.name: MessageEmergencyNoPhone
data.value: Emergency contact "{0}" has no phone number. Without a phone number this contact cannot be reached in an emergency.

data.name: SuggestionAddPhone
data.value: Add a phone number to this emergency contact.

data.name: CategoryWillBeforeMarriage
data.value: Will predates marriage

data.name: MessageWillBeforeMarriage
data.value: Your will was drawn up before your marriage or registered partnership. Its contents may no longer reflect your current situation (Civil Code art. 4:46).

data.name: SuggestionReviewWill
data.value: Consult your notary to have the will reviewed.

data.name: CategoryNoCtrNumber
data.value: Will without CTR number

data.name: MessageNoCtrNumber
data.value: A will is registered but no Central Will Register (CTR) reference number has been recorded. Heirs can use this number to retrieve the will after your death.

data.name: SuggestionAskNotaryCtr
data.value: Ask your notary for the CTR registration number and add it to your profile.

data.name: CategoryNoMarriageRegime
data.value: Marriage property regime not recorded

data.name: MessageNoMarriageRegime
data.value: You are married or have a registered partnership, but the marriage property regime has not been recorded. This regime determines the size of your estate (Civil Code art. 1:94).

data.name: SuggestionAddMarriageRegime
data.value: Fill in your marriage conditions in your profile.

data.name: CategoryDivorcedHeir
data.value: Ex-partner listed as heir

data.name: MessageDivorcedHeir
data.value: You are registered as divorced, but "{0}" is still listed as an heir with the relationship partner or spouse. Please verify whether this still reflects your wishes.

data.name: SuggestionReviewHeirs
data.value: Go to Heirs and verify that the list is up to date.

data.name: CategoryIdExpiry
data.value: Identity document expiring

data.name: MessageIdExpired
data.value: Your identity document has expired. A valid identity document is required for notarial deeds and banking procedures after death.

data.name: MessageIdExpiringSoon
data.value: Your identity document expires in {0} days. Make sure it is renewed in time for notarial deeds and banking procedures.

data.name: SuggestionRenewId
data.value: Renew your identity document and update the expiry date in your profile.

data.name: CategoryWilsverklaringVertegenwoordiger
data.value: Advance directive: representative not listed as emergency contact

data.name: MessageWilsverklaringVertegenwoordiger
data.value: The representative '{0}' listed in your advance directive is not registered as an emergency contact. In a medical emergency your representative must be immediately reachable (KNMG Guideline 2022).

data.name: SuggestionAddWilsVertegenwoordiger
data.value: Add your representative as an emergency contact or update the name so it matches.

data.name: CategoryWilsverklaringOud
data.value: Advance directive outdated

data.name: MessageWilsverklaringOud
data.value: Your advance directive is more than 5 years old (signed on {0}). The NVVE recommends reconfirming your advance directive at least every 5 years.

data.name: SuggestionHerbevestigWilsverklaring
data.value: Reconfirm your advance directive in the Advance Directive section.

data.name: CategoryHuisartsWilsverklaring
data.value: GP from advance directive not listed as emergency contact

data.name: MessageHuisartsWilsverklaring
data.value: Your treating GP '{0}' listed in your advance directive is not an emergency contact. Your treating doctor should be able to consult your advance directive quickly.

data.name: SuggestionAddHuisartsNoodcontact
data.value: Add your GP as an emergency contact with the role 'Huisarts'.

data.name: CategoryDonorBeslisser
data.value: Donor registration: decision-maker not listed as emergency contact

data.name: MessageDonorBeslisser
data.value: You have designated '{0}' as the decision-maker in your donor registration, but this person is not listed as an emergency contact. Immediate reachability is required in organ donation situations (Organ Donation Act art. 9).

data.name: SuggestionAddDonorBeslisser
data.value: Add your designated decision-maker as an emergency contact.

data.name: CategoryDonorNietOfficieel
data.value: Register donor wish officially

data.name: MessageDonorNietOfficieel
data.value: Your donor wish is recorded in Lumio but has not been officially registered with the Donor Register. Only an official registration has legal validity.

data.name: SuggestionRegistreerBijDonorregister
data.value: Register your donor wish at donorregister.nl for official legal validity.
